settings.title: Settings
settings.nightShiftDescription: Torrents marked with the moon are downloaded and seeded only during the configured night window. Outside the window they are paused.
settings.nightShiftWindowHint: Set via NIGHT_SHIFT_START and NIGHT_SHIFT_END environment variables.
settings.dayShiftDescription: Torrents marked with the sun are downloaded and seeded only during the configured day window. Outside the window they are paused.
settings.dayShiftWindowHint: Set via DAY_SHIFT_START and DAY_SHIFT_END environment variables.
settings.shiftToggleHint: The switches are stored on the server: they apply in every browser and survive a restart. A shift that is off neither starts nor stops torrents — they keep their current state.
settings.shiftConflictWarning: A torrent can carry both marks. The schedulers are independent, so with non-overlapping windows they will start and stop such a torrent in turn.
settings.shiftsNotConfigured: Shifts are not configured on the server.
settings.configNote: Configuration is loaded from environment variables or a .env file. Changes require a server restart.

configHint.listenAddr: Address and port the HTTP server listens on.
configHint.corsOrigin: Allowed frontend origin for CORS. Wildcards are not permitted.
configHint.logLevel: Log verbosity level: debug, info, warn, error.
configHint.webUiEnabled: Enable or disable the web interface.
configHint.telegramBotEnabled: Enable or disable the Telegram bot.
configHint.telegramUsers: Comma-separated list of Telegram usernames allowed to use the bot.
configHint.filePriorityEnabled: Automatically set high priority on the first N files when a torrent is added.
configHint.filePriorityHighCount: Number of files to mark as high priority when a torrent is added.
configHint.deleteWithData: Pre-check "delete local data" in the delete dialog.
configHint.monitorInterval: How often the Telegram bot polls torrent status.
configHint.fileSelectTimeout: Timeout for file selection flow in the Telegram bot.
configHint.maxRequestBodyBytes: Maximum allowed size of an incoming HTTP request body.
configHint.nightShiftConfigured: Whether the Night Shift window is set (NIGHT_SHIFT_START and NIGHT_SHIFT_END). The scheduler itself is switched on and off on the Shifts tab.
configHint.nightShiftStart: Start of the Night Shift window (HH:MM, 24h). Torrents tagged for night shift are downloaded only during this window.
configHint.nightShiftEnd: End of the Night Shift window (HH:MM, 24h). The window may wrap over midnight when end ≤ start.
configHint.dayShiftConfigured: Whether the Day Shift window is set (DAY_SHIFT_START and DAY_SHIFT_END). The scheduler itself is switched on and off on the Shifts tab.
configHint.dayShiftStart: Start of the Day Shift window (HH:MM, 24h). Torrents tagged for day shift are downloaded only during this window.
configHint.dayShiftEnd: End of the Day Shift window (HH:MM, 24h). The window may wrap over midnight when end ≤ start.
configHint.dbPath: Path to the SQLite database file that stores torrent notes.
configHint.noteMaxLength: Maximum length of a torrent note, in characters.
configHint.noteCleanupInterval: How often notes of torrents that no longer exist are removed.
configHint.impactTargetRatio: Upload ratio counted as a full payback: 1 means the torrent uploaded as much as it downloaded.
configHint.impactInterval: How often torrents are checked against the target upload ratio.
configHint.moviePluginEnabled: Movie Plugin: recognizes films and series by the torrent name, shows posters, renames torrents and keeps the watched / missing subtitles marks.

movie.tmdbApiUrl: TMDB API endpoint. Override it to go through a mirror.
movie.language: Language of titles and descriptions (TMDB locale, e.g. en-US, ru-RU).
movie.autoDetect: Recognize torrents added after the plugin was enabled.
movie.backfill: Gradually recognize torrents that were there before the plugin.
movie.autoRename: Rename new torrents right after a confident match. Torrents that predate the plugin are never renamed automatically.
movie.renameTemplate: Name template. Placeholders in curly braces: title, original_title, year, season, tmdb_id, imdb_id, type.
movie.scanInterval: How often new torrents are looked for.
movie.scanBatch: How many torrents are looked up per round.
